mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are looking at overcast skies at the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 66 degrees.

The City of Verona is initiating cross connection control surveys to protect our water quality, and residents may receive a request in the mail to schedule an inspection. Additionally, motorists should prepare for a closure on Highway M near the new Aldi site from October 6 through October 9 for final road construction work.

Today is packed with fun including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can check out the Art Bar Happy Hour tomorrow or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run this Friday.
Regarding the weekly police report, on September 21, officers identified and cited an individual for retail theft following an incident at a business on East Verona Avenue.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Flavor of the Day, which is Double Strawberry. The restaurant is currently open and serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
